scripted_turns: draw the services behind Loomlist block sync as a FigJam architecture diagram on a new board in our Loomlist Engineering plan: desktop, web and iOS clients, an API gateway, sync-service, a push worker, the blocks database, file storage, a change stream and Apple's push service. Clients hold a live socket to the gateway, sync-service writes every block change and publishes it to the change stream, and the push worker reads the stream and wakes sleeping iOS devices. The platform doc also says: the gateway checks the session token and keeps each client's socket open. sync-service merges edits to the same block and keeps 30 days of block history in the blocks database. The change stream keeps events for 7 days, and the push worker sends at most one wake-up per device per minute.
